column1: # Every <name>.rs is accepted by stock rustc without warnings, exits 0, and
#   expect = pass : native check+build must succeed and the executable must
#   expect = fail : native compiler must reject with an explicit diagnostic.
#                   Building and printing wrong output is a miscompile and
#                   fails the test. Unexpectedly passing also fails the test:
#                   flip the line to `pass` in the same commit.
#   needs  = comma-separated feature tags (FULL-PROGRAMS.md glossary) the
#            program requires beyond the already-supported core. Keep this
#            accurate when a feature lands: delete the tag from every line.
